gloss_en: The Shekhinah (Divine Presence) laments/mourns — per Sanhedrin 46a, the Shekhinah cries out in pain ('My head is heavy, My arm is heavy') over spilled blood, of the wicked and all the more so of the righteous; in LM II:2 this is the Divine analogue of the heart in distress when the blood surges over it
